reviews.title: Changed my life!
reviews.text: Mommas!! I have found the answer! Just a little history to make my point. I’m a momma of 3 that has suffered from diastasis recti, slowed metabolism, working full time, and running a busy household. My youngest is now 5 and I never lost the 50 lbs of baby weight plus the extra 30 lbs due to stress eating and lack of exercise I’ve put on in the past 5 years. I was hesitant to start any major core or exercise programs because I read core exercises can make the diastasis recti worse. I also didn’t have the time or money to go to physical therapy or hire a personal trainer to fix it. I’ve tried gyms and doing exercises I found online to try and fix it but nothing helped. Bringing us to now! I found Kayla’s instagram through a friend and started following her, amazed at how well she bounced back from having her baby girl. Then I found out she had a post-pregnancy exercise program on this app!!!! I figured if someone post pregnancy can do these exercises then myself, someone 5 years post pregnant and completely out of shape, could do them as well. I’ve been doing them for 5 weeks, and I’ll admit I couldn’t do some of the stretches or exercises well in the beginning but now I can! I tested my diastasis recti (google how to test if you don’t know - you can do it from home) and it’s completely gone!!!!! Gone! And I have sooo much more energy, I feel better, have lost 5 lbs, my clothes fit better, and I can keep up with my 5, 7, and 9 year old better than I could just 5 weeks ago. The best part!! She works you in slow and it fits into my busy schedule!! You start off with exercises that are possible, not too hard, and easy to do. The instructions are wonderful, the timing is easy to fit into any schedule, and the equipment is easy to find at Target, Walmart, or Amazon. I have cancelled my gym membership and I haven’t felt this good in 5 years. Thank you Kayla!!! I am a Sweat app lifer!

reviews.title: 7+ years of using this app
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Sweat for 8 years now and still love it!  I love that there are several different workout programs and that I can stick with a specific trainer for a couple of months before switching to a new one.  The app itself is very user friendly and easy to navigate.  

The workouts were difficult for me at first and I did consider deleting the app.  However, after reading BBG beginner forums, I realized that a lot of women struggle when they start.  I stuck with it and I am so glad I did!  I went from being someone who has never stuck with a workout plan for more than 2 weeks to being someone who regularly exercises 5x/week.  I now believe in Kayla’s “exercise anywhere” mentality and no longer make excuses for myself not to workout.

reviews.title: Love this women’s fitness app!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Sweat app consistently since 2018, and it has truly become a staple in my fitness routine. Lately, I’ve been using this app every single day, and whenever I stay consistent, I see amazing results—both physically and mentally.

What I love most is the variety and flexibility. Workouts range anywhere from 5 minutes to 90 minutes, which makes it easy to stay on track no matter how busy my day is. The app also includes yoga, stretching, and recovery sessions, which helps me build balanced weeks and avoid burnout or injury.

The programs are effective, motivating, and easy to follow, and I appreciate how everything is thoughtfully designed for women at different fitness levels. Each workout is designed based on your goals. Sweat has helped me stay disciplined, strong, and confident for years—and I honestly can’t imagine my routine without it.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for results, structure, and consistency in their workouts

When I started I had a few weights and bands, then over the years I have added more equipment here and there for my workouts. I can change a program to use what I have or substitute different movements. I like to recipe and meal option, but it would be nice to have a larger library. I wish you could log macros and have a tracking planning included with the app. I would prefer an all in 1 app rather than having multiple apps for different things. I feel like it would be easier. Another option they could add it a pause or vacation mode. Like when you aren’t able to do the workouts you could pause until you can. 
I highly recommend the app and program to anyone for any level of training.

reviews.text: Love the app and it’s features! If there are cues for breathing that can be added in the voiceovers that would be great! Can you add a pull up progression workout to teach us how to do a pull up? I think that would be an awesome program within the app!!

reviews.title: Body buster
reviews.text: Good

reviews.title: In love
reviews.text: Love it

reviews.title: Barre with Britney (beginner)
reviews.text: Amazing program! I hadn’t worked out since before my baby who is 1 year old now, and it has been a great program to build my strength and endurance, Challenge me, and sculpt my body with great ways to modify until my core got stronger.

reviews.title: Love, love, love this app!
reviews.text:
I'm an introvert so working out at home is best for me. Although I do have a gym membership, I only go there to use the machines. I rarely do my training there. I love the updated video feature. It keeps me motivated & it's like Kayla is right there training with me!! No regrets. So many great features more than before! Thank you Kayla & Sweat team! 

Virtual fitness from wherever you're at!

reviews.title: I LOVE this app
reviews.text: I’ve been using Sweat since Kayla released it, I even have the old digital prints from before the app was released.. and I love it! There are so many variations of programs which helps keep workouts exciting. I pair a different nutrition plan, but the workouts, water and step trackers are great!

reviews.title: It’s enjoyable
reviews.text: The only app that is enjoyable, there’s many workouts to chose from. Iv been using the sweat app for a few years and I love it. Find a workout that you enjoy, so you will keep doing it because consistency is the key to results. You won’t regret it!

reviews.title: Would love to follow more than one program
reviews.text:
Love the app but sometimes I want to follow more than one program, I like doing some Pilates but mostly have time for shorter workouts with weights. 

It would also be nice to be able to specify what kind of workout type  (reps vs timed intervals)

reviews.title: Sweat is Transformative
reviews.text: I love Sweat. It makes me feel empowered and I allow myself to try new things. My body composition has improved and I feel more confident. I love who I am in a routine and this feels like I finally found one. 7 years strong!

reviews.title: Favorite workout app
reviews.text: So great for beginners and experienced people alike. Love that there are videos that show you your form, that you can track the weight you lift, and so much more.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for strength training during very active periods of my life and for easing back into movement postpartum, and it’s so adaptable to different stages of fitness.

reviews.title: Amazing and convenient
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app. Between the plethora of workouts to choose from you have the convenience of choosing at home or a gym geared workout as well as different times of sessions. They also have a chat forum and recipes and food plans! Amazing app and worth even penny.

reviews.title: Very good app
reviews.text:
I like the app overall. 
Pros - I like how you can use it daily, the app schedules each workout and you just have to do what it says. I like that the equipment is customizable so that you only get exercises that you can do. I like that you can swap out an exercise if there is something that you can’t do or don’t want to do. 
Cons - I don’t think the beginner program is super beginner friendly. If you really have never exercised before, or if you’re a person in a larger body, some of the “beginner” exercises could use modification options.

reviews.title: Best trainer app
reviews.text: Strongly recommend to anyone looking to get a personal workout plan. Especially for those who are just starting to be comfortable working out.

reviews.title: Changed the game for me
reviews.text: This app has made it possible for me to be consistent with exercise. As a full time working mother of 2, I am BUSY. I find that half-hour to 40 minute work outs are completely doable for my lifestyle and I have seen a difference in my abilities as weeks progress. Thank you SWEAT!

reviews.title: Worth it and love it 100%
reviews.text: It gets me to move and feel good about moving that you’d want to do it again. The app is smart. The programs I start builds up automatically as if it’s an in person trainer and if I end a work out with a reason of too difficult for me or If I have a gap  in moving/exercising due to other life reasons. Then the next time I would search for a work out, it somehow understands and suggests based on my level and build up from there again.

reviews.title: Keep moving and sweat’n!
reviews.text: I’m really enjoying this app and all the workouts it has to offer. One thing I’d like to see is an eating plan for women in their 40+ years of age. This would help give variety at all levels of fitness and stages of life.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Love the app. Lots of variety wish though it was set up so there is a cardio section. I’m not finding that one yet. Also I wish that you could go back in like the day before two days before and still add your water and stuff back in. And if there was a spot where you could put your macros in or if the food you ate that would be great too, especially with all the great recipes that are around here.

reviews.title: Love this Program!
reviews.text: I’ve been a part of the Sweat / BBG community since 2014 and I’ve loved it so much! I’ve gotten in the best shape of my life doing it! No better program.

reviews.title: Sweat app
reviews.text: I love the sweat app, it has so many different options for whatever style or level of workout you want.

reviews.title: Wonderful Fitness Tool
reviews.text: This app is well worth the price.

reviews.title: PLEASE FIX
reviews.text:
If you accidentally hit skip on a section of a workout like the Super Set, there is no option to go back to the previous section it is SO annoying
And the skip button is huge so it’s easy to accidentally hit

Also there is no way to look up your weight history unless that days workout has you doing the exercise, would LOVE to be able to look that up

reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.text: I have been doing Sweat workouts for 6 years now and still have new things to try! It feels so good to have to buy heavier weights as the years go on. 💪🏽

reviews.title: Great work out app
reviews.text: This app has a lot of options and modifications and it totally woman centered. Love it!

reviews.title: Made my healthy lifestyle journey easier!
reviews.text: Wow I love this app it has everything I need. Different trainers for different goals or if I need to change it up when I am feeling tiered or have my period. It has new recipes everyday and keeps me motivated. I love this app!

reviews.title: I’ll always recommend this app
reviews.text: Started this subscription over 4 years ago. Great place to start if you’re a beginner and nice place to switch up your routine if you’ve been in the fitness game for awhile. Endless amount of options so you can find the right exercise plan for you. As a mother of three, this app has provided me the ability to choose a workout that fits my schedule, whether I have 10 minutes for something quick or an hour to dedicate to my workout. The programs are ever evolving so I have yet to get bored from a monotonous routine.

reviews.title: Great App!

I was using a different app before, but I’d like this one much better. I like that. I have a variety, that I can substitute when exercise for another if I choose and that I can play my own music! 

The workouts are curated very well.
